# Riad Developer

> Riad Developer (GitHub: RiadDeveloper) is a full stack developer who builds
> web apps, Android apps, bots, APIs and MIT App Inventor extensions.
> Website: https://riaddeveloper.is-a-good.dev
> GitHub: https://github.com/RiadDeveloper
> Email: riaddeveloperr@gmail.com
> Photo: https://riaddeveloper.is-a-good.dev/riad-developer.jpg

## Who is Riad Developer?

Riad Developer is a full stack developer. For years he built quietly — tools,
bots, apps and extensions — most of it published in the open on GitHub, long
before anyone was watching. He has 128 repositories on GitHub across 14
programming languages, and his blood group is B positive.

He is known for shipping fast: his Android app PyRunner went from idea to 11
releases in a single day. He works across the whole stack — TypeScript and
React on the front end, Python and Node.js on the back end, Flutter and Kotlin
on Android — and deep inside the MIT App Inventor ecosystem, where he builds
extensions (.aix) and the Aixfy toolchain that helps other developers build
them too.

## What does Riad Developer do?

- Full stack web development (front end and back end)
- Android app development (Flutter, Kotlin)
- Bots and automation (Python, TypeScript)
- API development (Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Flask)
- MIT App Inventor extensions (.aix) and tooling (Aixfy)

## Featured projects

- PyRunner (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/PyRunner) — Run and edit
  Python projects on your Android phone. Built with Flutter, Python 3.13 and
  Chaquopy. Flagship project; went from idea to 11 releases in one day.
- OneSignal-Extension
  (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/OneSignal-Extension) — OneSignal push
  notification extension for MIT App Inventor, Kodular and Niotron. Built
  with Java and the OneSignal SDK.
- Valid-Email-Checker
  (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/Valid-Email-Checker) — Email validity
  checker web app. Built with React, Vite and TypeScript.
- nextjs-ollama-llm-ui
  (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/nextjs-ollama-llm-ui) — Fully-featured
  web interface for Ollama LLMs. Built with Next.js and TypeScript.
- Extensions-Catalog
  (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/Extensions-Catalog) — Web app
  aggregating MIT App Inventor extensions from community forums. Built with
  React and TypeScript.
- FireLike (https://github.com/RiadDeveloper/FireLike) — Tool for Garena
  Free Fire players: profile info and automatic likes. Built with Kotlin
  for Android.
